name: zmodel_matl_get_pool_entry
description: zModel_Matl::GetPoolEntry maps serialized material-pool indexes to live material slots, returning null for negative indexes.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel material/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4805e0 validates negative-index null handling and zModel_MaterialSlot pointer calculation from g_zModel_MatlPool using the 0x2c slot stride.
The native material pool-entry smoke verifies -1 returns null and indexes 0 and 2 resolve to the expected g_zModel_MatlPool slots.
